name: Zephaniah
tagline: The day of the Lord and a restored remnant
author: Zephaniah.
date: Probably about 640 to 620 BC, in the reign of Josiah.
setting: Judah faces judgment, with a call to seek the Lord.
theme: God judges the proud and gathers the humble, rejoicing over them.

outline.label: Judgment and a call to seek the LORD

christInBook: The promise that the LORD will rejoice over his people with singing (3:17) is realized in Christ, who gathers the scattered and rejoices over them.
howToRead: Zephaniah begins with total judgment and ends with joyful singing. Notice how “the day of the LORD” is dark for the proud and bright for the humble.
